Let's check the infobox of the Wikipedia page for Moon to get the exact perigee value listed in the infobox (or minimum perigee value on the Wikipedia page for the Moon).
Let's print the infobox lines.
```python
cmd = """python3 -c '
import urllib.request
import json

url = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=revisions&rvprop=content&format=json&titles=Moon"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
res = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
data = json.loads(res.read().decode("utf-8"))
pages = data["query"]["pages"]
for k, v in pages.items():
    content = v["revisions"][0]["*"]
    lines = content.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines[:100]):
        if "perigee" in line.lower() or "orbit" in line.lower() or "distance" in line.lower():
            print(f"{i}: {line}")
'"""
out = await run_command(cmd)
print(out)
```
